Privacy Policy

Effective 5 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-05

This policy explains what personal data Rahul Vijay Singhania ("Astrobro.ai", "we") collects when you use the Astrobro.ai app and website, why we use it, who receives it, how long we keep it, and your rights. We are the "Data Fiduciary" for your data under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Digital Personal Data Protection Rules, 2025. We also follow the Information Technology Act, 2000 and the rules made under it.

In short: we use your birth details to calculate your charts and answer your questions. To write an AI answer we send your question and the relevant chart facts to our AI provider, without your email address. Card and UPI details go to Razorpay, not to us. We do not sell your data. You can see, correct and delete your data in the app. Astrobro.ai is for adults (18+).

1. What we collect and why

Your account

  • What: email address, account ID, sign-up date, last activity, and your password. Your password is handled only by Google Firebase Authentication; we never see it.
  • Why: to create and secure your account, sign you in, and contact you about your account, payments, safety and changes to these terms.

Birth details and saved profiles

  • What: name, date, time and place of birth (with its latitude, longitude and time zone) for you and for anyone you add, such as family members.
  • Why: to calculate charts, horoscopes, dasha, matching, reports and reminders.
  • Only add another person's details if they have agreed to it.

Location

  • What: if you allow it, your phone's location once, during set-up, to suggest your place. When you type a place name, it is sent to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service to find its coordinates.
  • Why: to fill in a place quickly and work out local sunrise and Panchang timings. We do not track your location in the background.

AI chat

  • What: your questions, the AI's answers and your chat history (kept in your account so you can return to it); short "memory" notes (your question and the first sentence of the answer) so the AI can remember earlier conversations; and a daily count of your chats.
  • Why: to answer you, show your history, keep the conversation relevant, enforce daily limits and prevent abuse.
  • Questions are checked automatically for signs of crisis so that the app can show helpline numbers. Memory notes are never made from messages that contain contact details or crisis language. You can see and delete memory notes in Settings → AI Memory.

Voice questions

  • What: a recording of your voice, made only while the microphone button is on.
  • Why: it is sent to our server and to Groq's speech-to-text service to turn it into text. We do not keep the recording after it has been turned into text; the text is then treated like a typed question.

Consultations with astrologers

  • What: the topic you enter, the birth details you choose to share (you can switch sharing off before each request), the chat messages exchanged, session times, minutes, charges, refunds, ratings, reviews and any reports of misconduct.
  • Why: to deliver the consultation, bill it correctly, handle refunds and disputes, keep users and astrologers safe, and show genuine ratings.
  • The astrologer sees your topic, the birth details you share and your messages. They do not see your email address or phone number.
  • Calls and video go through Jitsi Meet's servers. We do not record them.

Puja and pandit bookings

  • What: the service you choose, date and time, place or address, contact name, phone number and notes.
  • Why: to arrange and complete the booking. These details are shared only with the pandit assigned to it.

Payments and the wallet

  • What: order and payment IDs, amount, purpose, status and time; your wallet balance and transaction history; your plan and its expiry date. Card, UPI and bank details are entered with Razorpay and never reach us.
  • Why: to take payments, activate plans, give refunds, keep accounts, meet tax and legal duties, and prevent fraud.

If you apply to be an astrologer

  • What: name, bio, photo, languages, specialities, experience, rates, the UPI ID for your payouts, application status, earnings, payouts and session statistics.
  • Why: to review your application, show your public profile, pay you and meet tax duties.
  • Users see your name, photo, bio, languages, specialities, experience, rates, ratings and whether you are online. Your UPI ID is never shown to users.

Technical data

  • What: app version, device type and operating system, IP address, error logs and server request logs.
  • Why: to keep the Service secure and working, limit abuse, fix problems, and keep the security logs the law requires.

Advertising

  • Free users see ads from Google AdMob. Google may collect your device's advertising ID, IP address and information about how ads are shown and clicked, to deliver and measure ads and, if personalised ads are on, to choose ads for you.
  • You can turn personalised ads off in Settings → Personalised ads. You can also reset or delete your advertising ID in your phone's settings.
  • We never give advertisers your birth details, chats or email address.

What we do not collect

We do not access your contacts, messages, call logs or photos, and we do not track your location in the background. We do not make automated decisions about you that have legal effects. We do not sell or rent your personal data.

2. Your consent and other lawful reasons

  • When you create an account and tick the consent box, you agree to the uses described above. Some features ask for separate permission: location, microphone, notifications, sharing birth details with an astrologer, and personalised ads.
  • We may also use personal data without asking again where the law allows it: for a purpose you gave the data for voluntarily (for example, the phone number for a booking), to meet a legal duty, to respond to a court order or lawful request, or in a medical emergency.
  • You can withdraw your consent at any time, as easily as you gave it: turn off a permission in your phone settings, switch off birth-detail sharing, turn off personalised ads, delete memory notes or profiles, or delete your account. Withdrawing consent does not affect what was done before. Some features cannot work without the data (for example, a chart needs birth details).

3. Who receives your data

We share personal data only with the companies that help us run the Service, and only what each one needs:

  • Google LLC, Firebase (Authentication and Cloud Firestore): your account, saved profiles and chat history.
  • Google LLC, AdMob: advertising ID, IP address and device information, for free users.
  • Groq, Inc. (United States): AI answers and speech-to-text. It receives your question, the relevant chart facts (which can include the name on the chart), recent messages in the conversation, and voice recordings for transcription. It does not receive your email address or account ID.
  • Backup AI providers: when Groq is busy we may send the same information to a backup AI provider. We list any backup provider here before we start using it.
  • Railway Corporation (United States): hosts our server.
  • Supabase: hosts our database (account, wallet, consultations, bookings and memory notes).
  • Qdrant: hosts a search index of public-domain astrology books. A numeric representation of your question is used to search it; your question is not stored there.
  • Razorpay Software Private Limited (India): payments.
  • 8x8, Inc., Jitsi Meet: audio and video consultations.
  • OpenStreetMap Foundation, Nominatim: the place names you search for.
  • Astrologers and pandits: only what is needed for your consultation or booking.
  • Government bodies and courts: when the law requires it, for example under the Information Technology Act, 2000, or to protect someone's safety or rights.
  • A business that takes over Astrobro.ai: it must protect your data as this policy describes, and we will tell you before it happens.

4. Data stored outside India

Some of these companies store or process data outside India, for example in the United States. Indian law allows this except to countries the Government of India restricts. If a country we use is restricted, we will stop sending data there.

5. How long we keep your data

  • While your account is open: we keep your data so the Service works. You can delete profiles, chat history (Settings → Clear App Data) and memory notes at any time.
  • Voice recordings: not kept after they are turned into text.
  • Memory notes: only a limited number are kept; the oldest are removed automatically.
  • When you delete your account: we delete or anonymise your personal data within 30 days, except:
    • your basic registration details (email address, account ID and deletion date), which the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 require us to keep for 180 days after an account is deleted. We then delete them;
    • payment, wallet and billing records, which tax and accounting laws require us to keep (generally up to 8 years). We keep only what is needed;
    • messages and reports connected to an open complaint, dispute or legal request, which we keep until the matter is closed;
    • security logs, which we keep for up to 1 year.
  • Copies in backups are removed as the backups are replaced.

6. Your rights

Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you have the right to:

  • access: get a summary of the personal data we hold about you, what we do with it, and who we have shared it with;
  • correction and erasure: correct, complete or update your data, or have it erased. Most of this can be done directly in the app;
  • withdraw consent at any time (see section 2);
  • grievance redressal: have your complaints answered by our Grievance Officer;
  • nominate someone to exercise these rights for you if you die or become unable to do so;
  • complain to the Data Protection Board of India if you are not satisfied with how we handled your complaint.

To use any of these rights, email Vinaythetechguy@gmail.com from your registered email address. We may ask you to confirm your identity. There is no charge. We acknowledge requests within 24 hours and answer within 15 days.

7. Children

Astrobro.ai is only for people aged 18 or older. We do not knowingly collect data about children, and we do not track children or show them targeted ads. If you believe a child is using Astrobro.ai, write to Vinaythetechguy@gmail.com and we will close the account and delete its data.

8. How we protect your data

  • All data travels over encrypted connections (HTTPS).
  • Database rules allow each signed-in user to reach only their own data. Our server checks who is signing in before showing account data.
  • Payment details stay with Razorpay, which is certified under the PCI-DSS card security standard.
  • Only authorised administrators, checked by our server, can reach the admin tools.
  • If a data breach affects you, we will tell you and the Data Protection Board of India without delay, as the law requires, along with what happened and what you can do.

No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable steps to protect your data.

9. Phone permissions

  • Internet: needed for the Service to work.
  • Location (optional): once, during set-up, to suggest your place.
  • Microphone (optional): only while you record a voice question.
  • Notifications (optional): daily Panchang and personal reminders that you switch on.

10. Our website

Our website does not use tracking cookies or analytics. Its help chat answers from a fixed list of questions inside your browser and does not send your messages anywhere.

11. Changes to this policy

We will update this policy when our practices change and show the new effective date. If a change is important, the app will ask you to read and accept it before you continue.
